verdict.rationale: Mastra documents deploying its own Mastra server to any Node.js-compatible environment, including runtimes such as Cloudflare. That implies agents are reachable over a server. However, the evidence never shows a first-party managed runtime for production agents: Studio is described only as a hosted environment for testing and traces, and pricing stresses self-hosting. Missing for 10: a documented managed or hosted production runtime, explicit documentation of agent HTTP API endpoints and how to call them, and independent or hands-on corroboration of deploying and calling an agent endpoint.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can deploy an agent to a managed runtime and call it as an API endpoint

citations.quote: You can deploy a Mastra server or integrate with an existing web framework.
Mastra can run against any of these runtime environments: - Node.js `v22.13.0` or later - Bun - Deno - Cloudflare
Studio: A hosted visual environment for testing agents and running workflows, plus inspecting traces
